note: Grok Bot roster (Simon). Bots are shared: each one owns a kind of console or GUI work, not a project. The project is chosen per task (--project or keywords) and decides which bus the sheet and result land in. name = the name shown in the Grok Bot app. keywords route a task to its owner (most hits wins, ties go to list order). Work on a screen goes to a bot; repo code and CLI work stays with /vibe lanes.

2nd-b.note: Sheets and results accumulate in E:/2ndB/.bots/<bot>/inbox|outbox. .bots/ and marketing/ are excluded locally via E:/2ndB/.git/info/exclude, so no worktree shows them as changes. Simon's own code work happens in the worktree E:/2ndB/.worktrees/2ndB/TTL-Work_rev2.
